evidence: Swap (fail): a GP surgery appointment booker or a library meeting-room booker could take the masthead (bin glyph + council name in bold body text), the pale grey-green ground, white bordered cards, the green filled button, the outlined day chips and the time-tile grid unchanged; only the words ('Few left', 'gate', 'DRC-' permit) would change. With the name and copy hidden, nothing visual says 'recycling centre gate'.

Category-guess (fail): predicted default for a UK council service form is a near-white ground, one sober accent (often green for anything about waste), a single sans, bordered inputs, an error summary box headed 'There is a problem', a numbered step line. Every identity-carrying element on / , /vehicle.html, /confirm.html and /done.html matches that prediction.

Similar-prompt (fail): brief 'booking slots for a council's household-waste site in another district' would land on the same green-on-pale form, tile grid of times with availability tags, and a done page with the reference set as a heading inside a white card.

What is product-bound is copy, not design: 'Choose a day and the 20-minute slot you will arrive in; the gate checks the reference and the vehicle', 'Starts DRC-, then five digits', 'Rubble is limited to four bags'. That is product content on a frame that fails the swap test.

No signature: the slot grid is the generic mechanism of any booking product; the done page's reference DR-204117 is set as an ordinary bold heading in a full-width card, not as something drawn for the gate.

unfinished: Identity is only the council name in bold body text beside a small generic bin glyph (masthead, all routes).
Headings differ from body only by size and weight in the same face ('Book a slot', 'When', 'Slots', 'Your booking'); no typographic moment anywhere.
Half-empty right side at 1024-1440 on /vehicle.html and /confirm.html: content column stops at ~707 px leaving roughly half the canvas as bare ground.
Done page: band of empty ground below the footer at 1280x900 and 1440x900 (footer stops short, page ends mid-viewport).
Done page: full-width reference card stacked over a half-width 'At the centre' card, columns that stop short for no reason.
Done page, the one moment the resident keeps for the gate, has no focal treatment: 'DR-204117' is a bold heading inside a plain white card, with no day, time or vehicle beside it.
Phone number broken across lines at 375 ('01632 / 960771' in the 'At the centre' card and the footer).
Opening days card at 1280: text column fills ~half of a full-width card, empty right half.
